declarations.notes: Canonical principalE1 convergence on z ≠ 0 and |arg z| < pi, represented by shared continuedFractionConvergent with the exact alternating coefficient streams and a Tendsto convergence statement.
Nielsen and Lorentzen continued-fraction references are reproduced at https://dlmf.nist.gov/6.9#info.
The §6.9 continued-fraction context and principal-domain prose are reproduced at https://dlmf.nist.gov/6.9#p1.
The Cuyt et al. reference and surrounding source note are reproduced at https://dlmf.nist.gov/6.9#p2.

known_gaps: The DLMF page gives the infinite continued fraction but no separate truncation-error bound; finite continuants are formalized without an error estimate.
